items.title: Westwood: offshore rig dayrates mostly continue to fall in 2026
items.summary: Leading-edge jackup dayrates averaged just over $94,000/day year-to-date in 2026 (down 6% from 2025, ~24% below 2024's $123,000 average). Semisubmersibles averaged just under $340,000/day (Norway premium $436,000/day) and 6th/7th-gen drillships averaged ~$388,000/day. Global jackup utilisation fell 7 points year-on-year to 85%; floating rig utilisation slipped to 87%.
items.source_name: Riviera Maritime Media (citing Westwood Global Energy)

items.title: North Sea AHTS and PSV day rates hold firm on fleet attrition
items.summary: Large AHTS vessels in the North Sea are commanding $35,000-$55,000/day on short-term fixtures in 2026 (having briefly touched $60,000-$70,000/day in 2023-2024), while PSVs of 4,000+ DWT achieve $22,000-$32,000/day — levels not sustained since the 2013-2014 peak — driven by 300+ vessels scrapped or redeployed since 2015.

items.title: 2026 offshore challenge: softening demand puts brakes on day rates
items.summary: Near-term drillship day rates have fallen under $400,000/day amid expected 2026 oil oversupply exceeding 3 million boepd, though later contract work commands higher rates — over 40% of competitive 7th-gen drillships are already booked for 2027. Drillship utilisation is projected at 94% for 2026-2027, semisub utilisation rising to 88% in 2026, jackup utilisation holding at 91%+.

items.title: GCC jackup dayrates keep sliding as Saudi Aramco suspensions linger
items.summary: Average GCC jackup dayrates fell from $108,484 in 2023 to $91,735 in 2024 and $89,865 in 2025, with 2026 forecast to remain in the low-to-high $80,000s/day; committed Middle East utilisation is projected to decline from 91% (2025) to 89% (2026) as, of 37 jackup contracts Saudi Aramco suspended, 22 rigs have since mobilised out of or committed to leave the Kingdom.

items.title: OSV rates and utilisation levels roar back in Southeast Asia
items.summary: Day rates for 'backbone' 5,150-bhp AHTS vessels reached $8,100/day and 8,000-bhp AHTS units recovered to $12,000/day, while larger 10,000-12,000-bhp AHTS units chartered at $16,000-$19,000/day and PSVs (1,000 m² clear deck) commanded $33,000-$36,000/day amid a regional shortage of 8,000-bhp AHTS tonnage.
